metaDescription: Order custom paper full color pencils for eco-friendly branding. Perfect for trade shows and giveaways. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Paper full color pencils offer an eco-conscious alternative to traditional plastic pencils, made from recycled paper material that reduces environmental impact. These pencils are ideal for trade shows, school events, or corporate giveaways where sustainability matters. The paper barrel can be printed with your logo in vibrant full color, providing a large branding surface. Choose from the 12-Piece Colored Pencil Set for a colorful promotional item that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom paper full color pencils with vibrant printed logos, eco-friendly promotional giveaways.
